# Release highlights

Use three to six short highlights when warranted. Include only changes that help users decide to install or understand the release. Add a brief migration action or material limitation when needed. Do not copy the full changelog.

The final published line must link to the master changelog at the exact release tag:

```markdown
Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/shruggietech/insonic/blob/vX.Y.Z/CHANGELOG.md).
```

State Windows/Linux x86-64 support and both package choices: Desktop + CLI includes application windows and terminal commands; CLI-only contains no desktop application. Include actual publisher-signing disposition and link the matching installation/update/removal guidance. For 1.0.1, explain that macOS support is withdrawn while historical 1.0.0 records remain available.
